blogSections.title: Facing Volatility with Innovation
paragraphs: In much of Latin America, managing money often means navigating uncertainty. From currency volatility, high transaction fees and limited access to global financial services, individuals and small businesses face daily challenges in maintaining economic stability.

In this context, crypto is gaining traction not as a trend, but as a tool. Across the region, people are adopting cryptocurrencies, especially stablecoins and digital payment solutions to solve real problems—preserving value during times of volatility, receiving payments from abroad, and accessing digital finance without relying on traditional banking systems.

This shift is especially noticeable in cross-border payments. Traditional channels can be costly and slow, often involving multiple intermediaries. In contrast, crypto offers near-instant transfers, lower fees, and greater accessibility—even for those without a formal bank account.

What we’re seeing in Latin America is not a speculative rush, but a pragmatic transition: from digital assets to real-world utility. From holding crypto to actively using them in daily life. And from barriers to empowerment—powered by technology, and catered to local needs.

blogSections.title: Why Crypto Adoption in LATAM Is Different
paragraphs: Crypto adoption in Latin America is shaped by real-world needs rather than market trends. Unlike regions where crypto is often viewed through the lens of speculation or investment, in LATAM, it serves a more grounded function: offering financial tools where traditional systems fall short.
bullets: In countries with volatile exchange rates, crypto offers a more stable alternative for cross-border payments.
Freelancers and remote workers use stablecoins to receive payments from clients abroad—often faster and with lower fees than traditional methods.
Small businesses adopt crypto to access a broader customer base and reduce exposure to local currency fluctuations.
For many without access to conventional banking, crypto wallets offer a first entry point into global commerce.

faqs.question: What if my card expires — can I keep using it? Will it renew automatically?
faqs.answer:
Once your card expires, it can no longer be used, and automatic renewal is not supported.
If your card is expiring soon or already expired, you can apply for a replacement (renewal) in the app under the card's settings.
📌 Be sure to check and update your shipping address before requesting a replacement, as it will default to your previously saved address.

faqs.question: Why did my payment fail with the virtual card?
faqs.answer:
A failed transaction doesn't necessarily mean the card is faulty.
It could be due to several reasons:
▶ The merchant does not accept prepaid or virtual cards
▶ Your card has insufficient balance or no funds transferred in
▶ The card is inactive or past its expiration date
We suggest testing the card on another supported platform and checking the balance status. If issues persist, contact our support team with the transaction details.

faqs.question: How many times can I use this card? Does it expire?
faqs.answer:
NewPay cards are reusable and do not have a swipe limit — as long as there's available balance, you can keep using it.
Each card comes with a fixed expiration date (usually 2–3 years), which you can check in the card details screen.

faqs.question: Why can't I link my card to Apple Pay or Google Pay?
faqs.answer:
We understand how frustrating that can be — linking your card should be quick and easy.
But don’t worry, here are a few common reasons that might be causing the issue:
▶ The card hasn’t been activated or funded yet, please make sure your card is activated in the NEWPAY app and that you've transferred some balance into it.
▶ Some wallets try to make a small verification charge when linking a card — if your balance is zero, the process might fail.
▶ Card details were entered incorrectly.It’s easy to overlook small details. Be sure to double-check your card number, expiration date (MM/YY), and CVV.Even a single wrong digit or formatting issue can stop the card from linking.
▶ Your device or region may not be supported.Make sure your phone’s OS version and region settings are compatible with Apple Pay or Google Pay.Some devices or locations might not support wallet linking yet.
▶ Network issues can interfere. Sometimes the connection just isn’t cooperating. Try switching to a different network or restarting your phone, then attempt to link the card again.
If you’ve gone through all these checks and it’s still not working, feel free to take a screenshot of the error and contact our support team — we’re here to help.

faqs.question: I already have one virtual card — can I get another?
faqs.answer:
Of course, You can apply for multiple cards, but please note that each user can hold up to 5 cards in total, including virtual cards, physical cards, and gift cards.
Once you reach the card limit, it will no longer be possible to apply for new cards, and currently, disabling or deleting existing cards does not free up card slots.
We recommend organizing your existing cards based on different needs to keep things clear and efficient.
If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us anytime!

faqs.question: Can I use my physical card overseas? Will it be blocked?
faqs.answer:
Yes, definitely! NewPay physical cards support global use in countries and regions where Visa or Mastercard is accepted.
This includes online payments, in-store purchases, and ATM withdrawals.
There are no country restrictions on our end, but please note:
▶ Ensure your card is activated and has sufficient balance
▶ Some regions may have ATM or merchant limitations due to local policies or systems

faqs.question: My card didn’t work at the supermarket — Is there a problem with the card?
faqs.answer:
A failed in-store payment doesn't necessarily mean the card is faulty.
Common reasons for failure include:
▶ The merchant's POS terminal doesn't support your card type or had a read error
▶ Network issues or failure in the acquiring system
▶ The card hasn't been activated or has insufficient balance
▶ The transaction exceeded the card's limit setting
Please check that your card is activated and has enough balance. If the issue continues, try using the card at a different merchant or online. Feel free to contact support for help.

faqs.question: Can I use this card at gas stations or convenience stores?
faqs.answer:
Yes, both NEWPAY virtual and physical cards are compatible with Visa/Mastercard networks worldwide, including at gas stations, convenience stores, supermarkets, restaurants, and e-commerce sites.
Our cards are designed for broad international usability, online and offline.
Please ensure your card is activated and has sufficient balance. Some merchants may require tap-to-pay or chip-insertion terminals.

faqs.question: Why can’t I reactivate my card after deleting my account?
faqs.answer:
Once you delete your NEWPAY account, all cards and data are permanently erased and cannot be recovered or reactivated. This is due to:
▶ Data protection & privacy laws: We must fully erase your ID and account records after deletion
▶ Fraud prevention: We block repeat registrations with the same ID to prevent misuse.
▶ Regulatory compliance: Financial platforms must ensure one identity = one account, with no re-use after deletion.
We recommend you only delete your account if you are certain you no longer need the service. If you simply want a break, you can freeze your cards instead.

These requirements ensure we meet international KYC compliance standards.

faqs.question: My transaction keeps saying‘Pending.’Has the money been taken?
faqs.answer:
When a transaction is marked“Pending,” it means the merchant requested authorization, but the charge hasn’t been finalized yet.
This amount is temporarily held but won’t be deducted until the merchant completes the settlement process.
This usually takes 1–5 business days, depending on the merchant, bank, and holidays.
Please be patient — your app will update automatically once it’s completed.

faqs.question: My payment failed but money was still deducted — will I get it back?
faqs.answer:
Some failed transactions may appear as charged because of pre-authorization holds, which are used to verify transaction intent.
If the transaction ultimately fails, the hold will not be settled and will be automatically released back to your account.
This typically happens within 1–7 business days, depending on the merchant and settlement channel.

faqs.question: Why did my card binding fail during subscription setup?
faqs.answer:
Some merchants apply strict verification rules. Certain platforms may perform a small pre-authorization charge or require support for recurring payments. If the card doesn’t meet these technical requirements, the binding may fail.
Additionally, even if the first subscription appears free, many platforms may still attempt a small verification charge. If your card has insufficient balance, the verification may fail and prevent successful binding.
Lastly, some platforms only accept cards issued in specific regions, which may exclude NewPay cards depending on the merchant’s supported list.

faqs.question: I got a refund but the money doesn’t show up in the app yet. Why?
faqs.answer:
Refunds must be initiated by the merchant and returned through the same channel.
NewPay can only reflect the refund after we’ve received the funds from the merchant.
Depending on the payment gateway and merchant, refunds usually take 3–10 business days.
If it’s been longer than expected, feel free to contact our support team with refund details.

faqs.question: Can I download my transaction history or a billing report?
faqs.answer:
Yes! You can export transaction history within a custom date range in the app for bookkeeping or review.
Also, NewPay automatically sends a monthly statement to your registered email after each billing cycle.

faqs.question: I paid online but the page didn’t finish loading — was it charged?
faqs.answer:
If the payment page didn’t redirect or complete, it doesn’t always mean the transaction succeeded or failed.Here’s what you should do:
Check the [Transaction History] in the NewPay app to confirm if a payment was recorded.
Log in to the merchant’s platform to see if the order was created or marked as paid.
Make sure your network is stable when making payments to avoid errors or duplicate attempts

faqs.question: Can I pay in installments when spending?
faqs.answer:
NewPay cards are prepaid, not credit cards — so installment payments aren't supported.
All purchases are charged based on the available balance on your card. If there isn't enough to cover the full amount, the payment will fail.
We recommend checking your card balance before making large purchases.

faqs.question: Do I get notified after each payment?
faqs.answer:
Yes, NewPay sends instant alerts via app notifications whenever you make a payment.
To stay informed of your spending activity, please make sure app notifications are enabled on your device.

faqs.question: My wallet shows the transfer as successful, but I don’t see it in the app. Is it stuck?
faqs.answer:
“Transfer successful” in your wallet means the transaction was sent to the blockchain — but it still needs to be confirmed and synced with NEWPAY.
Typically, this takes 1–10 minutes depending on the network.
If it’s been over 15 minutes, please check:
Did you choose the same network (ERC20/TRC20) as shown on our page?
Did you send it to the exact address displayed in your NEWPAY recharge screen?
Did you meet the minimum recharge amount?
If everything checks out, please contact support and provide the transaction hash (TXID) for assistance.

faqs.question: Why is the deposit address different every time? Can’t I reuse the old one?
faqs.answer:
For security reasons, we use dynamic deposit addresses to prevent address tampering, leaking, or repeated accidental transfers.
Always use the latest address shown on the payment page. Please don’t reuse previous addresses to avoid any issues.

faqs.question: I just sent USDT, why hasn't it arrived yet?
faqs.answer:
Blockchain networks sometimes get congested, causing a delay in transaction confirmation.
Since USDT is a blockchain-based asset, the arrival time depends on the network you used (like TRC20 or ERC20), miner fees, and network traffic.

faqs.question: I withdrew USDT to my wallet, but it hasn’t arrived.
faqs.answer:
Once your withdrawal request is submitted, it enters the blockchain network for confirmation.
Transfer times can vary depending on network congestion — especially during peak periods.

faqs.question: Why do I have to enable 2FA when withdrawing?
faqs.answer:
To protect your account and funds, NEWPAY requires Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for withdrawals and other sensitive actions.
Even if someone knows your password, 2FA helps prevent unauthorized access to your money.
We recommend using the Google Authenticator app — setup takes just a few minutes and greatly improves your security.

faqs.question: My physical card has money, but the ATM says the balance is 0?
faqs.answer:
The balance shown at an ATM refers to the card balance, not your main account balance in the NEWPAY app.
There are two common cases:
Case 1: Funds already transferred to the card
→ Don’t worry — even if the ATM says 0, you can still withdraw if your card has sufficient balance. Some ATM systems simply don’t sync the balance correctly but the withdrawal still works.
Case 2: Funds are still in your main account, not on the card
→ Go to the NEWPAY app → [Card] section → Select your physical card → Tap [Transfer In] to load funds onto the card, then try again at the ATM.

faqs.question: My withdrawal show ‘processing/in progress’ — it already been deducted?
faqs.answer:
When your withdrawal status shows “Processing” or “In Progress,” it means your request is under review or being prepared for blockchain submission.
At this point, your funds are not yet deducted.
Once the transaction is approved and sent to the blockchain, the status will change to “Completed.”
If a transaction fails due to address issues or risk flags, it will be automatically canceled and the funds returned.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a withdrawal after submitting it?
faqs.answer:
Once a withdrawal has been submitted and passes internal checks, it will be broadcast to the blockchain (e.g., ERC20 or TRC20).
Since blockchain transactions are irreversible, they cannot be modified, canceled, or refunded after submission — by you or by us.
This is different from traditional bank systems, which sometimes allow reversals.
📌 Please always double-check the address, network, and amount before submitting to avoid irreversible loss.

faqs.question: Can I withdraw directly to my bank account?
faqs.answer:
Currently, NEWPAY doesn’t support direct withdrawals to bank accounts.
Instead, you can withdraw in two ways:
Withdraw USDT to a personal crypto wallet.
→ Network fee applies (gas fee), determined by blockchain, not NEWPAY
Withdraw cash using a physical card at ATMs
 → 2% withdrawal fee + applicable foreign exchange rate (based on bank rates)

Use a strong, unique password for your NewPay account. Reusing passwords across platforms increases your exposure to credential breaches and potential fraud.

faqs.question: Device & Network Safety
faqs.answer:
Use secure devices and networks to prevent unauthorized access and data interception.
▲ Avoid logging in through public Wi-Fi
Public networks can expose your data to malicious interception. Always log in to NewPay from a secure, trusted network — especially when performing sensitive actions like transfers or withdrawals.
▲ Keep your app up to date
Ensure you are using the latest version of the NewPay app to benefit from security patches and performance improvements. Updates often include critical fixes that protect you from emerging threats.

faqs.question: Card & Transaction Safety
faqs.answer:
Monitoring your card activity regularly helps detect and prevent unauthorized transactions.
▲Freeze your card if you notice suspicious activity
If you detect any unfamiliar transactions, use the in-app freeze function to instantly block your card and prevent further use. Then contact our support team for assistance.
▲Review your transaction history frequently
We recommend checking your transaction records on a weekly basis to verify all activity. If you notice anything unusual, report it to us promptly.

faqs.question: Account Deletion Notice
faqs.answer:

▲ Account deletion is permanent and non-reversible
Once your account is deleted, all associated cards, data, and history will be permanently erased and cannot be recovered. This policy complies with data protection regulations and anti-fraud protocols.

If you’re only taking a temporary break, we recommend using the card freeze feature instead of deleting your account. This allows you to retain your account and resume usage later if needed.

subItems: Through blockchain analysis techniques, transaction patterns may be associated with identities;
We may need to maintain records of associations between wallet addresses and identities to comply with legal requirements.

content.paragraph: We may use smart contracts to automatically execute certain functions. Regarding smart contracts:
subItems: All smart contract code is audited by independent third parties;
Smart contract operations may not be under our direct control;
Smart contracts may have vulnerabilities or technical limitations.

content.paragraph: We will provide relevant risk notifications and operational instructions before using smart contracts to process your data or assets.
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We share your data with third parties only in the following circumstances:
subItems: When necessary to provide services;
With your explicit consent;
When required or permitted by law.

content.paragraph: We share necessary data with the following categories of service providers:
All service providers are bound by Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) requiring them to:
subItems: Process data only according to our instructions;
Implement appropriate security measures;
Assist us in fulfilling our data protection obligations;
Return or delete data after service termination.

content.paragraph: We may disclose your personal data in the following situations:
subItems: In response to court orders, subpoenas, or other legal processes;
To comply with regulatory obligations such as anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing;
To protect NEWPAY's or users' rights, property, or safety;
To investigate suspicious transactions or violations of our terms of service.

content.paragraph: We assess the legality of each disclosure request and disclose only information necessary to satisfy the request.
If NEWPAY is involved in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your personal data may be transferred as part of the transferred assets. In such cases:
subItems: We will notify you before the transfer;
The new data controller will continue to be bound by this policy or at least a policy providing an equivalent level of protection;
You will have the opportunity to choose whether to continue using the services.

content.paragraph: As a global service, your data may be transferred, stored, and processed in locations outside your country/region of residence, including countries/regions that may not have equivalent data protection laws. We take the following measures to ensure the compliance of international data transfers:
subItems: Implementing Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission;
Ensuring the recipient provides an adequate level of data protection;
Obtaining your explicit consent for specific transfers (where applicable);
Only transferring data when appropriate safeguards are in place.

content.paragraph: You can contact our Data Protection Officer for more information about the safeguards for international data transfers.
We implement the following technical measures to protect your data:
subItems: Transmission encryption: All data transmissions use TLS 1.3 or higher encryption;
Storage encryption: Sensitive data is stored using AES-256 encryption;
Access control: Role-based access control and least privilege principle implementation;
Multi-factor authentication: Requiring staff to use multi-factor authentication to access systems;
Security monitoring: 24/7 real-time monitoring for system anomalies and intrusion attempts;
Vulnerability management: Regular vulnerability scanning and penetration testing;
Secure development: Following Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.

content.paragraph: We also implement the following organizational measures:
subItems: Employee training: Regular data protection and security awareness training for employees;
Access auditing: Recording and reviewing all data access activities;
Vendor assessment: Strict evaluation and monitoring of third-party service providers;
Incident response: Developing and testing data breach response plans;
Data Protection Impact Assessments: Conducting assessments for high-risk processing activities;
Security certifications: Following international security standards such as ISO 27001.

content.paragraph: In the event of a security incident that may affect your personal data:
subItems: We will notify relevant data protection authorities within 72 hours of discovery (if required by applicable law);
If the incident is likely to pose a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you directly;
The notification will include the nature of the incident, potential consequences, measures we have taken, and steps you can take.

content.paragraph: Protecting your data also requires your participation:
subItems: Use strong passwords and change them regularly;
Enable two-factor authentication (2FA);
Keep your devices and software updated;
Be vigilant against phishing attacks and suspicious links;
Do not save login states on public devices;
Report suspicious activities promptly.

content.paragraph: We determine retention periods based on data type and purpose:

rows: Until consent withdrawal or account closure

content.paragraph: In special circumstances, such as unresolved disputes, legal proceedings, or regulatory investigations, we may need to extend the retention period for specific data.
To reduce the impact on your privacy:
subItems: We regularly review stored data and delete information no longer needed;
Where possible, we anonymize rather than delete data, making it no longer capable of identifying individuals;
For statistical and analytical purposes, we prioritize using aggregated and anonymized data.

content.paragraph: When retention periods expire or upon your deletion request:
subItems: We use secure deletion methods to remove data from active systems;
Backup data will be overwritten during normal backup cycles (maximum 30 days);
Third-party service providers will be instructed to delete relevant data;
We will provide deletion confirmation.

content.paragraph: Due to the technical characteristics of blockchains, on-chain data (such as transaction records) typically cannot be deleted. In such cases:
subItems: We will delete information in off-chain systems that might associate this data with your identity;
We will take technical measures to make this data practically inaccessible;
We will clearly explain which data cannot be fully deleted due to technical limitations.

content.paragraph: Depending on applicable laws in your region, you may have the following rights:

rows: Obtain a copy of your personal data that we process
Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data
Request deletion of your personal data in specific circumstances
Subject to legal obligations and technical limitations
Limit our processing of your data in specific circumstances
Receive your data in a structured, commonly used format
Only applies to data processed by automated means
Object to processing based on legitimate interest
We may demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds
Withdraw previously given consent at any time
Does not affect lawfulness of processing before withdrawal
Right not to be subject to automated decision-making
Not be subject solely to automated decision-making

content.paragraph: You can exercise your data rights through the following methods:
subItems: Via the "Privacy Settings" feature in the application;
By sending an email to support@newpay.org;
By mailing a written request to our registered address.

content.paragraph: Please include in your request:
subItems: Your full name and contact information;
The specific right you wish to exercise;
Any information that helps us locate your data.

content.paragraph: We may need to verify your identity to protect your and others' data security.

We will respond to your request within one month of receipt. If the request is complex or you submit multiple requests, we may need an additional two months, but we will notify you of the extension and reasons within one month. We generally do not charge fees for exercising data rights. However, if a request is manifestly unfounded, repetitive, or excessive, we may:
subItems: Charge a reasonable administrative fee; or
Refuse to respond to the request.

content.paragraph: In some circumstances, we may not be able to fully satisfy your request, for example:
subItems: When laws require us to retain certain data;
When data is related to ongoing transactions or legal claims;
When fulfilling the request would disclose personal data of others;
When technical limitations (such as blockchain data) make complete deletion impractical.

content.paragraph: If we cannot fulfill your request, we will explain why and inform you of possible alternatives.

If you believe our processing of your personal data violates data protection laws, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. We encourage you to contact us first so we have the opportunity to address your concerns.

We use cookies and similar technologies (such as web beacons, pixel tags, device identifiers) to provide, improve, and protect our services. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us identify your browser or device.
We use the following types of cookies:

rows: Help us understand how users use our services
Used for advertising and content personalization

content.paragraph: Some cookies are set by third parties, including:

subItems: Analytics service providers (such as Google Analytics);
Social media platforms (such as Facebook, Twitter);
Advertising partners.

content.paragraph: These third parties may use cookies to collect information about your activities on our website and other websites. We do not control these third parties' use of cookies. Please review the relevant third parties' privacy policies for more information.
You can manage cookies through the following methods:
subItems: Browser settings: Most browsers allow you to view, manage, delete, and block cookies;
Cookie banner: When first visiting our website, you can choose to accept or reject non-necessary cookies;
Preference center: You can change your choices at any time through the "Cookie Preferences" page on our website.

content.paragraph: Please note that blocking certain types of cookies may impact your experience and available features when using our services.

Some browsers send "Do Not Track" (DNT) signals. As there is currently no industry consensus on how to interpret these signals, we do not currently respond to DNT signals. However, you can use the methods described above to manage your cookie preferences.

sections.title: 11. SUPPLEMENTARY PRIVACY RIGHTS FOR SPECIFIC REGIONS

subsections.title: 11.1 European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, and Switzerland Users

content.paragraph: If you are located in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, in addition to the rights described elsewhere in this policy, you also have:
subItems: The right to lodge a complaint with your country/region's data protection authority;
The right to seek compensation for material or non-material damage suffered due to our violation of the GDPR in certain circumstances;
The right to know the logic involved in automated decision-making and its potential impact on you.

content.paragraph: Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), California residents have additional rights, including:
subItems: The right to know what personal information we have collected, used, disclosed, or sold in the past 12 months;
The right to request deletion of certain personal information (subject to certain exceptions);
The right to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information;
The right not to be discriminated against for exercising privacy rights.

content.paragraph: We do not "sell" your personal information but may "share" certain information with third parties for targeted advertising. You can opt out by clicking the "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link at the bottom of our website.

We are committed to respecting the privacy rights of all users, regardless of their location. If the laws in your region grant you specific data protection rights, we will respect those rights. Please contact our Data Protection Officer to learn about specific rights in your region.
We have appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) to oversee our data protection strategies and compliance. You can contact our DPO through:
subItems: Email: support@newpay.org

content.paragraph: For general privacy inquiries or to exercise data rights:
subItems: Email: support@newpay.org

content.paragraph: We commit to:
subItems: Acknowledging receipt of your privacy-related inquiry within 2 business days;
Providing a substantive response within 15 business days;
Maintaining transparent communication and notifying you in advance if we need more time.

content.paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect:
subItems: Changes in laws and regulations;
New business practices or service features;
User feedback and suggestions;
Evolution of security best practices.

content.paragraph: When we make significant changes to this policy, we will:
subItems: Notify you via email or in-app notification at least 30 days before implementing the changes;
Highlight the changes on our website and in our application;
Provide a summary of policy changes, highlighting important modifications;
Update the "Last Updated" date at the top of the policy.

content.paragraph: For minor changes (such as clarifications or error corrections), we may not provide separate notification but will update the "Last Updated" date.

Continuing to use our services after policy updates take effect indicates your acceptance of the revised policy. If you do not agree with the new Privacy Policy, you should stop using our services and close your account.

Protecting your privacy is our top priority. We are committed to handling your personal data in a transparent, responsible, and respectful manner. If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions regarding this Privacy Policy, please do not hesitate to contact us. We value your feedback and will continuously strive to improve our privacy practices.

subItems: User commission applies to all registered users, issued according to fixed ratios or activity cycles;

sections.title: IV. Commission Issuance and Settlement Mechanism

content.paragraph: 4.1 All commission amounts will be settled uniformly by the platform. Promoters do not need to apply separately; the system will automatically trigger the commission issuance process when settlement conditions are met.
4.2 Commission Currency and Payment Settings a. Commissions are issued by default in USDT to the wallet address bound by the Promoter on the platform;

b. Promoters must ensure that their bound wallet addresses are authentic, valid, and controlled by themselves or their organizations. The platform assumes no responsibility for commission failures or losses due to incorrect information, lost addresses, or similar issues;

c. Promoters may manually change their wallet addresses, which will trigger risk control mechanisms, including but not limited to GA (two-factor authentication) requirements, 24-hour withdrawal suspension, etc.; NewPay has the right to extend the verification period or require additional identity verification based on risk assessment.

4.3 Settlement Mechanism and Cycle a. The platform does not set fixed issuance cycles. Once the accumulated commission amount in a Promoter's account reaches 100 USDT, it enters the issuance schedule;
b. If the commission amount in the Promoter's account has not reached the minimum threshold, the system will automatically accumulate it until the conditions are met;

c. If the Promoter's account or the behavior of their referred users is under risk review, the platform has the right to indefinitely suspend commission settlement until the review is completed; Promoters have no right to object to this.
d. NewPay reserves the right to adjust the minimum settlement amount and settlement cycle according to business needs, without prior notice to Promoters.

4.4 Issuance Exceptions and Dispute Resolution a. If commission records are found to be abnormal, data has been tampered with, addresses have been abused, or there are associations with fraudulent accounts, NewPay has the right to freeze, withhold, and audit related commission records;

b. If a Promoter is ultimately determined to have engaged in violations, the platform has the right to cancel their commission eligibility and recover commissions already issued. Whether to refund is at the platform's sole discretion based on the actual circumstances;

c. All commission-related records are based solely on the platform's backend system data as the only valid reference. Promoters may not claim settlement requests based on screenshots, external records, etc.;

d. Promoters must report any commission anomalies to the platform within 7 calendar days of discovery. Failure to do so will be deemed as acceptance of the platform's settlement results and waiver of any right to object.

4.5 Final Right of Interpretation NewPay has the final right of interpretation regarding commission issuance time, issuance order, settlement logic, and accounting processing, and reserves the absolute right to dynamically adjust commission system rules, risk control mechanisms, currency selection, etc., without further notice.

Using VPNs, changing device fingerprints, or other methods to circumvent risk control, implementing "self-recommendation" or "team internal commission cycling"; c. Fabricating transaction behaviors, including but not limited to false deposits, orders without actual consumption, creating refund cycles, and other means;

d. Using NewPay brand names, LOGO, pages, card images, etc. for external promotion without written authorization; e. Spreading false promotional content, including but not limited to fabricating platform returns, exaggerating commission ratios, or falsely claiming official identity; f. Freeze related accounts and commission funds;
Recover issued commissions;
Report to law enforcement agencies or cooperate with regulatory investigations;
Pursue civil compensation or criminal liability.

content.paragraph: 5.3 Promoters understand and expressly agree that: NewPay has final discretion in determining violations and is not required to disclose all risk control bases for individual cases. Promoters may not raise objections to platform decisions for any reason.

sections.title: VII. Applicable Law and Dispute Resolution

content.paragraph: 7.1 This Policy and related matters, including but not limited to commission eligibility, commission issuance, account disputes, and violation handling, their establishment, interpretation, performance, and dispute resolution, shall all be governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China, without application of any conflict of law provisions.
7.2 Any disputes arising from or related to this Policy shall first be resolved through friendly negotiation between the Promoter and the platform through NewPay's official customer service channels.

7.3 If negotiation fails, the Promoter and NewPay may choose either of the following dispute resolution paths: a. Submit the dispute to the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre (HKIAC), to be arbitrated according to its currently effective arbitration rules. The arbitration language shall be English, and the arbitration award shall be final and binding on both parties; or b. File a lawsuit with a court of competent jurisdiction in Hong Kong, China.

subItems: Maliciously abusing the appeal mechanism by repeatedly submitting invalid disputes;
Deliberately spreading unverified dispute information, guiding public opinion against the platform;
Conspiring with others to collectively create disputes, affecting platform operations or other users' interests.

content.paragraph: 7.5 The Promoter understands and expressly agrees that: the commission program is part of the platform's operational strategy, and NewPay has the final right of interpretation and adjustment of this Policy. Any dispute resolution should proceed with respect for the platform's autonomous operational rights.

7.6 If any provision of this Policy is deemed invalid or unenforceable, it shall not affect the validity of the remaining provisions. The invalid or unenforceable provision shall be interpreted as the valid provision closest to the original intention of both parties.

7.7 The Promoter expressly agrees that, under any circumstances, NewPay's maximum liability for compensation to the Promoter shall not exceed the specific commission amount involved in the dispute, and NewPay shall not be liable for any indirect losses, expected profit losses, or punitive damages.
